text: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
author: Sun Tzu
visual_brief: A clean engineering cross-section of a high-mass flywheel suspended within a gimbaled housing. Centerlines, dimension ticks, and circular rotation arrows reveal the heavy rotor spinning at peak momentum inside a completely stationary, balanced outer frame.
alt: White line engineering section of a gyroscope spinning in perfect equilibrium
